title: Browser-heavy offline application
spec: Build a pnpm-only offline-first React application with a local mock API, 40 deterministic UI scenarios, Vitest component tests, and Playwright Chromium tests covering desktop and mobile viewports. Generate 100,000 searchable records. Do not create npm, Yarn, or Bun lockfiles. Root scripts must include test, test:e2e, build, and typecheck. Browser tests must reuse one configured web server and clean it up.
prompts: Create the application, typed local API contract, deterministic record generator, and component-test foundation.
Implement indexed search, filtering, pagination, optimistic edits, and accessibility-focused component tests over 100,000 records.
Add 40 Playwright scenarios across desktop and mobile projects while configuring one reusable web server.
Add offline recovery, corrupted-cache handling, and regression tests for rapid filtering and navigation.
Run typecheck, component tests, browser tests, and production build. Fix failures, verify no server remains, and write BENCHMARK_RESULTS.md.
